invest.mp.gov.in's current (new) front-end is a client-side-rendered React SPA at sws.invest.mp.gov.in that returns no server-rendered text via curl; all verified sources above are instead static assets (PDFs) and the 'old_portal' legacy WordPress site under the same invest.mp.gov.in domain, which do render real content via curl.

Reaching https://invest.mp.gov.in/ at all required working around a server-side 'unsafe legacy renegotiation disabled' TLS error (OpenSSL 3.0 default) by setting OPENSSL_CONF to explicitly allow UnsafeLegacyRenegotiation; this was needed only for the SPA shell pages, which were ultimately excluded anyway since they render no content.

labour.mp.gov.in and services.mp.gov.in (the MP Labour Department's own site and e-services portal) — which secondary sources repeatedly cite as the actual venue for online Factory License/Form No. 4 filing per the 2021 MP Factories Rules amendment — were both unreachable this session due to TLS handshake resets on the government server side; this is a real gap and these should be re-attempted in a later verification pass or from a different network path.
